entities.summary: Mikhail Abramovich Morozov was a Russian businessman, arts patron and collector during the Belle Époque. He was the eldest son of Abram Abramovich Morozov, the elder brother of the collector Ivan Morozov (1871-1921) and the husband of the art collector Margarita Morozova (1873-1958).
